audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the final seven StringsFromMaps pirate-cove lines. Speaker labels, pirate voice, win-loss distinctions, prize state and invitation meaning were preserved.

records.english: DART MAN: Well, shiver me timbers! That's a perfect game!
records.translation: ГРАВЕЦЬ У ДАРТС: Лусни мої щогли! Це бездоганна гра!

records.english: DART MAN: Well, sink me! That's some good throwing!
records.translation: ГРАВЕЦЬ У ДАРТС: Чорти мене забирай! Оце кидки!

records.english: Here's a little something for ya.
DART MAN: Yar... Better luck next time...
records.translation: ГРАВЕЦЬ У ДАРТС: Ар-р... Наступного разу пощастить...

records.english: BARTENDER: Oi! I never seen the likes o' you, before. But if ye got the pirate look, then 'ave one on me! Har Har!
records.translation: БАРМЕН: Гей! Раніше я тебе тут не бачив. Але якщо вигляд у тебе піратський, пригощаю! Ха-ха!

records.english: BARTENDER: Back fer more, eh? Har Har! You've had enough, matey...
records.translation: БАРМЕН: Знову по добавку, еге ж? Ха-ха! З тебе вже досить, друже...
